propositions: The close precheck resolver emits ambiguity diagnostics to stderr for unrelated historical commit references during history scan.
resolve_ticket_id writes three separate stderr prints (lines 229-233, 249-254, 270-274) without distinguishing between user-supplied and history-scanned references.
_referencing_commit_exists calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference in every reachable commit message, triggering unrelated ambiguity errors.
The precheck gate semantics and return values are unaffected by the diagnostic noise since ambiguous resolves return None either way.
Adding a quiet keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr prints and is passed as True only from the history-scan loop.
User-facing commands that explicitly resolve ambiguous prefixes retain full diagnostics because quiet defaults to False.
